payload.core_mechanism_summary: Checks for a common digit (1-9) between the two lists; if exists, print smallest common digit. Else take min from each list and print concatenated min-max two-digit number.
payload.rationale: Solution is purely constructive/greedy based on observation, not involving any search algorithm. The digit loop is trivial and not a genuine backtracking search. Hence, it does not match any complete_search subtype.
